attempts.party: party_darksteel76.json (Incineroar / Urshifu-Single / Kingambit / Mega Scizor / Flutter Mane / Hydreigon)
attempts.why: Espeon and Starmie led. Turn 1 Fake Out flinched Espeon's Calm Mind attempt (it had chosen Dazzling Gleam), Scarf Starmie's Hydro Pump took Urshifu to its Sash-less 61 (no Sash trigger: 201 of 262), Wicked Blow one-shot Starmie. Turn 2 Urshifu Protected the Dazzling Gleam and Knock Off killed Espeon; Reuniclus Focus Blast into the Protect. Turn 3 Beheeyem Protected and Wicked Blow did only 25 percent through it (Champions-gen Unseen Fist rule, see legality notes); Reuniclus set Trick Room. Turn 4 Sucker Punch killed Beheeyem but Reuniclus' Focus Blast killed Incineroar exactly (219/219). Turn 5 Mega Scizor's U-turn took Reuniclus to 93 while Focus Blast killed the 61-HP Urshifu; Medicham's High Jump Kick crashed into the Flutter Mane that U-turn brought in. Turn 6 Bullet Punch beat Reuniclus' Recover and Moonblast killed Medicham, but Medicham's High Jump Kick had already put Scizor at 37. Turn 7 Kingambit replaced Scizor, Mega Latias' Psychic did nothing to it, Moonblast took Latias to 13, Trick Room ended, and Moonblast finished it. Two faints and a genuine fight; the examiner's Focus Blast Reuniclus and Pure Power Medicham did the damage.

turn 1: Hydro Pump resolved before Wicked Blow, 201 damage on Urshifu

turn 6: High Jump Kick 226 on Mega Scizor; turn 5 it crashed into Flutter Mane
Latias Mega-evolved and used Psychic into Kingambit (immune) on turn 7, then died; it chose neither Calm Mind nor Recover at 13 HP versus a faster Flutter Mane
no terrain, it chose Protect then Thunderbolt; both my battlers were Dark so Expanding Force was correctly not chosen

protect_summary: 1 Protect, real payoff. No empty guards.
ai_notes: Turn 7 Mega Latias chose Psychic into a slot that had just become Kingambit (immune). It committed its move before the switch; confirmed from the battle messages ('It doesn't affect Kingambit'), not the chosen record. Not a defect. Turn 5 Medicham's High Jump Kick into the U-turn-replaced Flutter Mane is the same situation. Reuniclus preferring Focus Blast on my Dark types every turn was correct and won it two knockouts.
level_change_rationale: Won with 2 faints after a real fight; brief step 5 says keep.
cooler: The examiner concept shows: each species felt like the stronger version of the earlier room's copy, and with no field effect to hide behind the room still took two of my six. Kathleen is a keeper. If anything, Espeon could carry Yawn or a screen so its Magic Bounce is tested instead of being the first thing Fake Out removes.
legality_notes: Sets legal as authored. Engine rule note for all Urshifu-based benchmarks: src/battle_util.c GetConfig(B_UNSEEN_FIST_PIERCING_DRILL) >= GEN_CHAMPIONS makes Unseen Fist deal 25 percent through a single-target Protect (message 'couldn't fully protect itself') rather than the Gen 8-9 full damage. Deliberate config, not a defect, but earlier receipts that call it 'pierced the guard' mean this reduced hit.
